confidence: High for the 10 media-producing core accounts (lazy_patriot930, mellow_ranger534, true_river921, quiet_atlas278, north_ember718, local_fox863, lazy_pixel298, true_ranger65, real_atlas225, blue_otter565): four independent signals agree. High-to-medium for the 2 text-only amplifiers (real_river38, lazy_river856): no images, so no forensic link, but they share the creation burst, post verbatim copies of the network's false narratives, and 100% of their reposts are fast (<6 h) reposts of core posts.
evidence_summary: (1) Shared forensic TTP: the 10 core accounts each posted 3-5 images whose FKG region shows the same post-processing chain Resampling(scaleFactor ~0.71-0.96) > GaussianBlur(sigma ~0.47-0.73) > GaussianNoise(amount ~1.03-1.39), all ReCompressed, mostly on FLUX-attributed fully synthetic or AI-edited images (q07, q08, q14). No other account has more than one such image (q15, q28). The chain holds even where the FKG verdict says Authentic or names a camera, so the shared processing fingerprint is a stronger link than the noisy verdict. (2) False narratives: their posts carry three of the four False-rated claims (dam opened on purpose, relief centres turning people away without ID, mayor fled by private plane), posted in a burst from Oct 3 to Oct 5. The claim matcher misses many of these posts, but the wording is verbatim the same across accounts (q22). (3) Copy-paste text: only the 12 accounts post word-for-word copies of the core's false-claim posts (q23). Organic users post hedged variants instead ('...Need answers.', 'Is it true...?'). (4) Account burst and network: 13 accounts were created Sep 10-13 2026, after a gap of 11 days with no new accounts (q09, q10). 12 of them repost each other densely (q11). The two amplifiers made 16 reposts in all, every one a core post reposted within 6 h (q19). The core accounts' early posts (Sep 12-30) are generic filler, which fits warming up new accounts before the campaign. (5) Provenance: core images were re-uploaded by outside accounts (q13).
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: (a) Ordinary rumour spreading: about 25 older accounts also posted false-claim content, but in hedged template wording, with unrelated images (various generators, NoPostProc) and no shared processing fingerprint. The tap-water claim (Sep 25-30) spread only among such organic accounts, with no TTP or repost ties to the network (q21). (b) Organic re-sharers of campaign images: rusty_harbor678, local_patriot982 and sunny_willow249 each carry exactly one signature image, and provenance links show it was copied from a core post. wild_ranger624 carries one signature image with no provenance link (detection can miss links). wild_ranger20 re-uploaded a core image (q13). All are older accounts with a single questioning or hedged post and no repost ties to the network, so they look like people taken in by the campaign rather than members (q15, q17, q28). (c) A second, benign coordinated cluster: six older accounts (local_cedar896, rusty_atlas425, rusty_atlas897, sunny_atlas47, daily_ember163, quiet_cedar104) share their own AI-image TTP (Resampling ~0.5 > Sharpening ~0.8) on Sep 28-29. They run a product-marketing push ('Aurora Trail'), with no false-claim matches (q24-q26). This is coordinated, but it is not disinformation, so the false-claim requirement excludes it. (d) Account-age coincidence: mellow_comet121 was created in the same Sep 13 window but posts only benign content, has no signature images and no network ties, so it is excluded (q22, q11). (e) Forensic and matcher noise: the FKG gives some campaign images an Authentic verdict or a camera source, and some unrelated users' AI images get Manipulated verdicts. The claim matcher misses many campaign posts and has false hits (for example, a sandbag post matched to both a True and a False claim). The conclusion therefore rests on agreement across signals, not on any single verdict or match. (f) Older accounts that quickly reposted core posts (blue_maple418, sunny_patriot10, sunny_atlas704, sunny_willow392, real_atlas246) post only hedged organic wording, never verbatim network text, and have long histories. They are treated as organic engagement (q19, q29). This is the least certain exclusion.
criteria_used_by_detector: Generic, with only thresholds. 'False-claim post' means a post the claim matcher links to a claim whose ClaimReview rating lies in the bottom quarter of its own scale. CORE: the account has >=1 false-claim post AND >=2 distinct images whose FKG region contains a consecutive non-NoPostProc op pair (op1 fkg:hasNext op2). That pair must be matched (same two op types in the same order, both estimated parameters within 0.12) in images posted by >=2 other accounts that also have false-claim posts. AMPLIFIER: the account reposted posts of >=2 distinct core accounts, each within 6 h of publication, AND one of its own false-claim posts is a verbatim text copy of a core account's post. Output: the union of CORE and AMPLIFIER. On this dataset it returns exactly the 12 accounts listed.
